description: The encrypted feedback drop (CT-91, Whombat FD-13 … FD-16): RFC 9180 A.1.1, envelopes sealed with the fixed `ikmE` (base64url, or length + sha256 for the large classes; the plaintext is `plaintextOf(descriptionLength)` in conformance/src/feedback-drop-vectors.ts), tampered envelopes with the error opening them must give (`privateKeyFor` knows only the recipient), signed site cards with `verifySiteCard`’s answer, references and padding.

cards.name: swapped encryption key, re-signed by another key
small-order key, identity R, S = 0 (ZIP-215 accepts)
